auton.cpp

Functions

void imuAverage()

function that averages the inertial sensor values to reduce drift

void colorDetector()

function that flips a boolean if it detects the correct color in the top intake. Used to stop the intake.

void colorDetector2()

Same as previous fn but it is impartial to the alliance color.

void detectColor()

delays the code until it detects a block in the bottom intake and then stops the intake. This is used in auton when we are at the match loader

void detectTopColor()

delays the code until it detects a block in the top lift and then stops the intake and lift. This is used in auton when we are at the match loader

void stopTheIntake()

used with the aforementioned colordetect and stopIntake booleans to stop the intake when we first intake our alliance colors block. This stops the block from flying out of our intake, and gets rid of the need to micromanage the lift to keep the blocks in.

void runAuton()

Called during the beginning of the match and starts the autonomous task using a switch.

Variables

auton_type autonType = NONE

Defines autonomous codes for each side, Ex. blue left, blue right, and skills.

bool autonConfirmed = false

Boolean that, when true, will make the autonomous run.

bool isRed = true

Used to know what color to eject in the autonomous.

bool testing = false

Testing variable that is used to run a specific code without needing to select an autonomous.

bool intakeStopped = false

boolean to know if the intake was just stopped by the optical sensor
